name: Masala Egg Bhurji
short_description: Spiced scrambled eggs with onion, tomato and green chilli.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add tomato and green chilli, cook until soft.
Add turmeric and salt, stir well.
Crack in the eggs and scramble until just set.
Serve hot with toast or roti.

name: Aloo Tomato Masala
short_description: Comforting potato and tomato curry with warming spices.
instructions: Heat oil and splutter cumin seeds.
Add onion, garlic and ginger, saute until golden.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates.
Add potato, coriander powder and salt.
Add a splash of water, cover and simmer 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Garnish and serve with rice or roti.

name: Ginger Garlic Chicken Stir Fry
short_description: Quick weeknight stir fry with chicken, carrots and corn.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok over high heat.
Add garlic and ginger, stir for 30 seconds.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 6 minutes.
Add onion, carrot and corn, stir fry 5 minutes.
Season with salt and serve hot.

name: Banana Milk Smoothie
short_description: A quick creamy smoothie to start the day.
instructions: Peel and slice the banana.
Blend banana, milk and yogurt until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve chilled.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
short_description: Classic fried rice loaded with carrots, corn and spinach.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok, saute garlic and onion.
Add carrot and corn, stir fry 3 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Add cooked rice and salt, toss well over high heat.
Serve hot.

name: Cheesy Garlic Toast
short_description: Crispy bread with melted cheese and garlic.
instructions: Preheat a pan or oven to medium heat.
Mix cheese with minced garlic.
Spread onto bread slices.
Toast until cheese melts and bread is golden.
Serve warm.

name: Comforting Lentil Soup
short_description: A hearty, protein-rich lentil soup with garlic and spices.
instructions: Rinse lentils and boil with water until soft, about 15 minutes.
In a separate pan, heat oil and splutter cumin seeds.
Add onion, garlic and ginger, saute until golden.
Add tomato and cook until soft.
Pour the tempering into the cooked lentils.
Season with salt and simmer 5 minutes.

name: Spinach Cheese Omelette
short_description: Fluffy omelette packed with spinach and melted cheese.
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt in a bowl.
Heat oil in a nonstick pan.
Saute onion and spinach until wilted.
Pour in whisked eggs, tilt pan to spread evenly.
Sprinkle cheese, fold, and cook until set.
Serve hot.

name: Home-Style Chicken Curry
short_description: Rich, spiced chicken curry simmered with tomato and onion.
instructions: Heat oil and saute onion until golden brown.
Add garlic, ginger and green chilli, cook 1 minute.
Add tomato puree and turmeric, cook until oil separates.
Add chicken pieces and sear on all sides.
Add salt and water as needed, cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Serve hot with rice.

name: Apple Cinnamon Yogurt Bowl
short_description: A refreshing no-cook breakfast bowl.
instructions: Dice the apple into small cubes.
Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with diced apple and serve chilled.

name: Sweet Corn Carrot Salad
short_description: A crunchy, refreshing salad perfect as a light snack.
instructions: Combine corn, carrot and onion in a bowl.
Add green chilli and salt.
Toss well and serve chilled.

name: Egg Fried Rice
short_description: Everyday fried rice with scrambled egg and vegetables.
instructions: Scramble eggs in hot oil, set aside.
In the same pan, saute garlic, onion and carrot.
Add cooked rice and salt, toss well.
Fold in scrambled eggs.
Serve hot.

name: Grilled Chicken Sandwich
short_description: A hearty grilled sandwich with juicy chicken and cheese.
instructions: Season and pan-sear chicken until cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Assemble bread with chicken, cheese and onion.
Grill the sandwich until bread is golden and cheese melts.
Slice and serve warm.

name: Spiced Potato Sandwich
short_description: Toasted sandwich with a spiced mashed potato filling.
instructions: Mash boiled potatoes with onion, chilli and salt.
Spread the mixture onto bread slices.
Toast on a pan with a little oil until golden.
Slice and serve hot.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
short_description: Restaurant-style fried rice with tender chicken pieces.
instructions: Cook chicken in hot oil until browned, about 7 minutes.
Add garlic, onion and carrot, stir fry 4 minutes.
Add cooked rice and salt, toss thoroughly.
Serve hot.

name: Vegetable Poha
short_description: Light and fluffy flattened rice with peas, onion and spices.
instructions: Rinse flattened rice and drain well.
Heat oil, add onion and green chilli, saute until soft.
Add carrot and turmeric, cook 3 minutes.
Fold in the flattened rice and salt gently.
Cook 3-4 minutes and serve hot.

name: Egg Curry
short_description: Boiled eggs simmered in a spiced onion-tomato gravy.
instructions: Heat oil and saute onion until golden.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 minute.
Add tomato puree and turmeric, cook until oil separates.
Add boiled eggs (halved) and salt.
Simmer 10 minutes and serve with rice or roti.

name: Classic Garlic Bread
short_description: Buttery, garlicky toasted bread.
instructions: Mix minced garlic with oil and salt.
Spread onto bread slices.
Toast in a pan or oven until crisp and golden.
Serve warm.

name: Creamy Carrot Soup
short_description: Silky soup made from carrots and aromatics, finished with milk.
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add carrot and enough water to cover, simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in milk and salt, reheat gently.
Serve warm.

name: Simple Chicken Soup
short_description: A soothing broth-based chicken soup with vegetables.
instructions: Combine chicken, garlic, ginger and water in a pot.
Simmer 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken, shred, and return to pot.
Add onion and carrot, simmer 10 more minutes.
Season with salt and serve hot.

name: Tangy Tomato Rice
short_description: Zesty one-pot rice cooked with tomato and spices.
instructions: Heat oil, saute onion and garlic until golden.
Add tomato puree and cook until thickened.
Fold in cooked rice and salt.
Cook 5 minutes, stirring gently, and serve.

name: Banana Pancakes
short_description: Fluffy pancakes made naturally sweet with ripe banana.
instructions: Whisk mashed banana, milk and egg together.
Fold in flour until just combined.
Heat a lightly oiled pan and pour batter in rounds.
Cook until bubbles form, flip and cook other side.
Serve warm.

name: Spinach Lentil Dal
short_description: Nutritious lentils cooked with spinach and warming spices.
instructions: Boil lentils until soft, about 15 minutes.
Heat oil, splutter cumin seeds, add garlic and onion.
Add tomato, cook until soft.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Combine with cooked lentils, season with salt, simmer 5 minutes.

name: Yogurt Salad Bowl
short_description: Cool and light yogurt bowl with crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Whisk yogurt until smooth.
Fold in chopped onion and tomato.
Season with salt and chill before serving.

name: Chicken Tikka Bowl
short_description: Grilled spiced chicken served over rice with yogurt.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garlic, ginger and salt for 20 minutes.
Pan-sear or grill chicken until charred and cooked through.
Serve over cooked rice.

name: Veggie Flour Wrap
short_description: Soft homemade flour wraps filled with spiced vegetables.
instructions: Knead flour with water and a little oil into a soft dough.
Roll into thin rounds and cook on a hot pan until lightly browned.
Mix mashed potato with onion, chilli and salt.
Fill each wrap with the potato mixture and roll up.
Serve warm.

name: Classic Egg Sandwich
short_description: A simple, satisfying boiled egg sandwich.
instructions: Mash boiled eggs with onion and salt.
Spread the mixture between bread slices.
Slice and serve.

name: Corn Cheese Toast
short_description: Toasted bread topped with sweet corn and melted cheese.
instructions: Mix corn, cheese and onion in a bowl.
Spread the mixture on bread slices.
Toast or bake until cheese melts and bread crisps.
Serve warm.

name: Ginger Garlic Fried Rice
short_description: Aromatic fried rice fragrant with ginger and garlic.
instructions: Heat oil, saute ginger, garlic and onion until fragrant.
Add cooked rice and salt.
Toss well over high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Chicken Keema Omelette
short_description: Protein-packed omelette with spiced minced chicken.
instructions: Cook minced chicken with onion and chilli until browned.
Whisk eggs with salt and pour over the chicken mixture.
Cook until the egg sets, folding once.
Serve hot.

name: Buttery Potato Carrot Mash
short_description: A creamy, comforting mash of potato and carrot.
instructions: Boil potato and carrot until tender, about 15 minutes.
Drain and mash with milk and salt.
Serve warm.

name: Apple Milk Oats Bowl
short_description: Warm, wholesome oats simmered with milk and apple.
instructions: Simmer milk gently in a saucepan.
Stir in oats and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Fold in diced apple.
Serve warm.

name: Egg Tomato Curry
short_description: Boiled eggs in a light, tangy tomato curry.
instructions: Heat oil, saute onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomato and cook until pulpy.
Add halved boiled eggs and salt.
Simmer 8 minutes and serve.
